# Code Anchors: Delegating Port

- `libs/delivery-config/src/config-cli.ts` — the resolver whose implementation the port moved first, now reached as a verb with no delegation left behind it.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/run.ts`, `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/report.ts` — the story filer's ported implementation, the last-but-one row to flip.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/cutover.spec.ts` — the cut-over guard, asserting no interpreter is spawned on any path without importing a constant that no longer exists.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/run.ts` — the epic filer's ported implementation, the last row to flip.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/cutover.spec.ts` — the same guard for the epic filer, rewritten rather than deleted when the seam went.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/corpus` — the frozen golden corpus the port preserved byte-for-byte, its identity being the property under test.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the single registry the ported rows live in, needing no second registry for the port.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/build-bundles.ts`, `package.json` — the entry point and manifest that carried the new and retained forms together while a row still delegated, reduced once none did.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/environment-guard.ts` — the old runtime's requirement, diagnosed for exactly as long as one delegating row survived.
